The '''DN-724''' was a model of [[Forensics droid/Legends|forensics droid]] that was produced during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. These roughly-[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] droids were noted for the way that they shuffled their feet while walking.
